Package com.smu.mysql

Interface NodeDaoMySQL

public interface NodeDaoMySQL
MySQL implementation of the Merkle tree node records DAO, against the pre-existing nodes table. The table is provisioned externally, not by this class.

The columns are named start_index/end_index rather than start/ end, because END is awkward to use unquoted in MySQL (control-flow keyword). Bind parameter names (e.g. :start) still match MTC_AppendOnly_Node_Record's accessor method names for @BindMethods; SELECT columns are aliased back to those names for @RegisterConstructorMapper.

Nodes are uniquely identified by the composite key (start_index, end_index).
